text:
carmen: Quick thread  proposal: compress org/workspace crumbs into a single "pill" to save horizontal space. Keep 'Serving' as the visible top-level. Thoughts?

lucas: I like it for narrow screens. Need keyboard behavior: pill should expand on Enter and be tabbable. Also ensure aria-expanded on the control.

ada: Agree. For deep-links we should prefer path-based anchors for shareability, e.g. /.../serving/overview/traffic instead of query ?panel=. Use query alias for older links.

carmen: Good call. Implementation note: replaceState on initial load when alias is used to avoid history spam, pushState when user manually navigates.

ux-bot: Accessibility reminder: when route changes, move focus to main H1 and announce via aria-live: "Serving  Traffic". Truncated crumbs must expose full label on focus.

lucas: Motion: expand/collapse should be subtle, 120ms. Avoid layout shift that reflows content. Consider using transform scale for the pill expansion.

ada: Telemetry: add alias-redirect, pill-expand, deep-link-share events. We'll use a feature flag for rollout and a 90d alias period.

infra-bot: Note: CDN and caching treat full path as cache key. If we create many unique canonical paths, add cache rules for static assets only.

carmen: I'll mock variations (pill with chevron, pill with hover preview) and post assets. Also drafting migration copy: "We've grouped Models & Deployments under Serving. Your bookmarks will keep working."

lucas: Minor copy tweak: use active voice and mention how long aliases last. e.g., "We've moved Models and Deployments under Serving. Existing bookmarks will continue to work for 90 days."

ada: Thanks — I'll prep keyboard/accessibility test cases and a small QA checklist.
_reserved: do not add extra nested fields
